scope: Targeted primary-source and review navigation set; not an exhaustive or latest-paper survey. No PDFs or copied figures included.

sources.title: A human embryonic limb cell atlas resolved in space and time
sources.access_scope: indexed Results, Discussion, Methods and Fig. 4 legend excerpts
sources.interpretation_pattern: State atlas → measured spatial localization → nominated regulator → MSC knockdown followed by myocyte-gene readout. Separate molecular consequence from a complete in vivo developmental mechanism.

sources.title: Spatially organized multicellular immune hubs in human colorectal cancer
sources.access_scope: PubMed abstract and publisher-indexed abstract/highlights; full publisher page returned 403
sources.interpretation_pattern: Across-tumor co-variation of programmes is followed by spatial localization of candidate multicellular hubs. Localization strengthens anatomical interpretation without being an intervention.

sources.title: Lineage tracing on transcriptional landscapes links state to fate during differentiation
sources.access_scope: indexed Results and Fig. 2 legend excerpts; direct PMC open encountered browser challenge
sources.interpretation_pattern: Measured clonal links connect earlier transcriptional states with later fate. The interpretation explicitly depends on tested sister-cell similarity, illustrating why state and fate are not interchangeable.

sources.title: Transfer learning enables predictions in network biology
sources.access_scope: indexed abstract, figure titles, extended-data legends and contributions; not full main text
sources.interpretation_pattern: Distinguish representation/prediction evidence from the separately reported experimental validation in cardiac microtissues. In silico perturbation must not be relabelled as a performed wet-lab intervention.

sources.title: Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression
sources.access_scope: indexed Results, Discussion, Methods and availability text
sources.interpretation_pattern: The study challenges an initially plausible explanation, tests biological-replicate handling and uses orthogonal in situ evidence. Preserve alternatives, specimen-level uncertainty and negative controls rather than selecting the method with the most discoveries.

sources.title: Human lung cancer harbors spatially organized stem-immunity hubs associated with response to immunotherapy
sources.access_scope: indexed abstract and first Results subsection
sources.interpretation_pattern: Pretreatment tissue organization is associated with later therapy outcome. Retain the observational treatment-response scope rather than claiming the tissue hub was proven to cause response.

sources.title: Deep-learning-based gene perturbation effect prediction does not yet outperform simple linear baselines
sources.access_scope: indexed Main, Methods, limitations and figure legends
sources.interpretation_pattern: Compare prediction targets with matched simple baselines and inspect systematic errors. The negative result is task- and dataset-scoped; it does not prove that all biological AI is ineffective.

sources.title: Scientists rise up against statistical significance
sources.access_scope: indexed introduction and bibliographic details only; conceptual commentary, not an experiment
sources.interpretation_pattern: The opening critiques interpreting a nonsignificant result as no difference. Use this as a conceptual caution, not as empirical evidence for a biological claim.

sources.title: Revealing gene function with statistical inference at single-cell resolution
sources.interpretation_pattern: Review-level context connecting molecular profiling, perturbations, cohorts and phenotype. Detailed rules in this module are author-defined and require the project-specific methods, not abstract-only authority.

sources.title: The diversification of methods for studying cell–cell interactions and communication
sources.access_scope: PubMed metadata and available indexed review introduction; navigation reference
sources.interpretation_pattern: Read the relevant measurement and computational sections when interpreting communication. Do not treat one ligand–receptor inference as equivalent to every experimental class of communication evidence.
